description: Locale configuration for Tamil language in Moment.js, including date formats, relative time, and numeral mappings.

methods.name: ordinal
methods.description: Returns the ordinal string for a given number in Tamil.

methods.name: preparse
methods.description: Converts Tamil numerals in a string to Western numerals.

methods.name: postformat
methods.description: Converts Western numerals in a string to Tamil numerals.

methods.name: meridiem
methods.description: Determines the Tamil meridiem string based on the hour.

methods.name: meridiemHour
methods.description: Converts a Tamil meridiem string and hour to a 24-hour format hour.
